screens.title: Game home
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished, production-quality mobile game UI screen for Tambola Circle, a friendly Indian family tambola game. SINGLE SCREEN ONLY, edge-to-edge portrait app screenshot in a strict modern PHONE ASPECT RATIO 9:20 (prefer 1080x2400 pixels, or a very close phone ratio). No multi-screen collage, no handset bezel, no angled phone, no external captions. Entire image is the screen. Consistent premium playful board-game art direction: midnight plum to royal purple soft background with restrained tiny stars and faint number-ball motifs at edges; warm golden-yellow dimensional pill buttons with a small tactile darker bottom lip; crisp chunky rounded sans-serif titles, highly legible simple body text; ivory paper ticket surfaces, thin perforation seams, bold dark numerals; turquoise secondary controls. Friendly, joyful, polished game UI, never a generic business dashboard. Clear hierarchy, minimum readable phone text, plausible 44-point controls, safe internal edges. Avoid casino imagery, roulette, cards, neon clutter, money/cash icons, gradients behind dense numbers, excessive whitespace and small illegible text. Brand name exactly “Tambola Circle”. Coin symbol is a gold circular C token; coin values are illustrative play-credit examples. Avatars are friendly illustrated initials/faces. All interfaces belong to the same game. Do not include the old manual review, challenge or public table modes. Each ticket panel is standard tambola: THREE ROWS and NINE COLUMNS, exactly FIVE NUMBERED cells and FOUR BLANK cells per row, fifteen numbers total; blanks remain empty ivory. Use realistic ascending number columns and bold numerals. Marked numbers have a strong RED circular filled disc with WHITE numeral, not only a thin outline. UI controls and board grids must be clean and geometrically aligned.
SCREEN 01 — GAME HOME.
Top compact row: left circular avatar P and “Hi, Priya”; right golden coin chip “1,200” with a small plus button.
Upper hero occupying only about 30 percent of screen: delightful rounded golden “TAMBOLA CIRCLE” wordmark, a small floating physical tambola ticket with colorful 23/46/90 number balls and a few star sparkles. Keep it tasteful and truly like a game lobby, no slogan.
Below hero, THREE large vertical game buttons in this exact order: 1) gold “Play online” with two-player icon, biggest; 2) purple/turquoise outlined dimensional “My tables” with round table icon and a tiny “1 live” badge; 3) ivory/plum “Offline caller” with numbered ball and speaker icon. My tables must sit immediately after Play online.
At bottom three compact round navigation buttons with labels: “Coins”, “How to play”, “Settings”. No generic dashboard cards, no big whitespace, no public/private choice, no web nav. Rich clean illustration, lovely polished icons, believable implementable mobile UI. The image itself must be a single tall 9:20 phone screen.
screens.note: Play online → My tables → Offline caller. Illustrated game buttons and coin balance.

screens.title: Play online
screens.spec: SCREEN 02 — PLAY ONLINE HUB. Reuse the reference image's exact illustrated game art style, rounded typography, purple background and gold buttons, but make the hero compact. Top back arrow, “Play online”, coin chip “1,200”. Small cheerful table with friends illustration. Two large tactile cards vertically: gold “Create table” with friendly table icon and small lock label “Private · Friends & family”; then turquoise “Join table” with invitation-ticket icon and subtext “Use a code or invite”. Below a compact resume card “Family Friday”, “Round 4 is live”, “Rejoin” button. Bottom small helper “Watching is always free”. Beautiful clean mobile game navigation. NO public mode, NO visibility selector. Single 9:20 screen.
screens.note: Only private tables. Create, join by code/link and resume ongoing games.

screens.title: Your player profile
screens.spec: SCREEN 03 — ANDROID PLAYER REGISTRATION. Top back and title “Join the circle”. Compact cheerful avatar illustration above a beautiful ivory game-ticket-shaped form. Name field “Priya”. Label “Mobile number”; ONE read-only greyed ivory input shows “+91 90000 00000”, small phone/SIM icon, and a clearly separate purple underlined “Change” link to its right. No list of SIM numbers. Small legible helper “Selected from your device · not verified”. Consent row with check icon and text “Save my name, number and device ID for my player profile.” Large gold button “Continue”. Ivory panel titled “Table code” with six bold rounded input boxes reading “4 8 2 6 1 9”. Gold “Find table” button. screens.title: Live ticket marking
screens.spec: SCREEN 09 — IMMERSIVE LIVE PLAYER GAME. No Android/iOS status bar or OS navbar. Compact upper strip “Family Friday · Round 4”, sound icon. A gold current number ball “46” occupying only 15 percent screen height; adjacent “Previous 23” replay speaker; small but clear badges “28 called” and “62 left”. Left edge small turquoise expandable control “Numbers” with grid icon; right edge small purple “Players · 6” icon. BOTH DRAWERS CLOSED, do not show full player or history list. The remaining roughly 75 percent of height is vertically scrolling tight ivory paper ticket strip with four complete THREE-row NINE-column tambola panels and partial next, tiny perforation seams, no giant gaps. Every ticket header has “Ticket 1” at left, small “9 / 15” progress in middle, stable compact gold “Full house!” button on right aligned with that same ticket. Thick readable numerals, unnumbered empty cells, five filled cells per row. Several selected number cells display RED FILLED CIRCLES with white numerals. Tiny gold stars burst tightly around one freshly tapped red 46 cell, never obscuring nearby cells. First panel exact rows: 3,-,23,-,41,-,62,-,81 / -,12,-,34,-,56,-,74,86 / 8,18,-,-,46,-,68,79,-.
